title: White Noise Source: MM5837 / MM5437 Replacement
summary: A pure white noise generator on an 8-pin PIC 12F675, as a drop-in replacement for the obsolete MM5837/MM5437 used in the Prophet-5, Korg Mono/Poly and Oberheim OB-X.
